The Gamewell-FCI SM7100-L8 is a 7100 Sounder Module supplied as a replacement part for Gamewell-FCI 7100 Series fire alarm control panels. Gamewell-FCI describes the 7100 Series as a multi-processor-based, analog addressable fire alarm control panel intended for commercial, industrial and institutional installations, so this module is aimed at technicians maintaining existing 7100 systems.

Key Features

  • Replacement sounder module designated by Gamewell-FCI for the 7100 Series platform
  • Intended for service and repair of installed 7100 Series fire alarm control panels
  • Genuine Gamewell-FCI part number for accurate matching against panel parts lists

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Gamewell-FCI (Honeywell)
  • Part Number: SM7100-L8
  • Product Type: Sounder module, replacement part
  • Panel Family: Gamewell-FCI 7100 Series analog addressable fire alarm control panels

Compatibility

Designated by Gamewell-FCI as the 7100 Sounder Module for replacements on 7100 Series fire alarm control panels. Compare the part number and board revision on the panel being serviced before ordering.

The Siemens FN2001-U1 is the SAFEDLINK network module used to connect several fire panels over the FCnet/C-WEB system bus. It plugs onto the panel's PMI & mainboard in the left main-module slot (X13), and Siemens specifies that it may only be used for networking in a fire detection system.

Key Features

  • Connections for a system bus input and a system bus output
  • Integrated degraded mode function with signal transfer in the event of line trouble
  • Electrical isolation (1 kV) between the FCnet/C-WEB system bus and the panel
  • Supervised for short circuit, open circuit, ground fault (detected at <1 kΩ) and communication errors
  • Up to 3300 ft (1005 m) between two network modules; wiring power limited per NFPA 70 / NEC 760 with no EOLR required
  • Green RUN LED plus yellow status LEDs for circuit 1 and circuit 2

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Siemens
  • Part Number: FN2001-U1
  • Supply Voltage: 24 VDC
  • Current: 35 mA standby, 35 mA alarm
  • SAFEDLINK Bus: 5 VDC, 120 Ω impedance
  • Protocol: SAFEDNET (UDP/IP); 312 kbit/s standard or 96 kbit/s low data rate
  • Cable: Shielded or unshielded; 12–22 AWG

Compatibility

Networks Siemens fire panels via the FCnet/C-WEB system bus. Siemens references separate Class A and Class B SAFEDLINK network configuration documents for Desigo and Cerberus PRO systems.

The System Sensor SMB500-WH is a bright white surface mount box for intelligent control or monitor modules. Honeywell describes SMB500 boxes as being for use with System Sensor modules when flush or recessed mounting is not possible, so it gives installers a finished surface-mount option wherever an in-wall electrical box is not practical.

Key Features

  • Surface-mount enclosure for intelligent control or monitor modules
  • Bright white finish
  • Provides a mounting option where flush or recessed mounting is not possible
  • Named in Notifier literature as the optional surface-mount backbox for FMM-1(A), FZM-1(A) and FDM-1(A) modules
  • UL/ULC listed per Honeywell
  • Honeywell lists the SMB500 for use across its Farenhyt, Gamewell-FCI, Morley-IAS and NOTIFIER brands

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: System Sensor (Honeywell)
  • Part Number: SMB500-WH
  • Product Type: Surface mount box (backbox)
  • Color: Bright white
  • Listings: UL/ULC listed

Compatibility

For System Sensor intelligent control and monitor modules. Notifier's DN-6720 datasheet states that FMM-1(A), FZM-1(A) and FDM-1(A) modules may be mounted to the SMB500 surface-mount box.

The Simplex 4100-1292 is a panel-mounted LCD annunciator, called the Remote Command Center option in Simplex remote annunciator literature. Installed in a 4100U/4100ES-style remote annunciator, it gives responders and building staff a 2 x 40 character status readout of the fire alarm system at a location away from the main control panel.

Key Features

  • 2 line by 40 character LCD with LED illumination
  • LED illumination stays off during supervisory and turns on with an alarm or when switches are activated
  • Remote Command Center module for LCD status readout and keyswitch-controlled functions
  • Mounts in the top bay of the annunciator; 4100ES/4100U flat modules are allowed behind it
  • RUI device: requires an RUI/RUI+ connection from the host panel

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Simplex
  • Part Number: 4100-1292
  • Display: 2 x 40 character LCD, LED illuminated
  • Supervisory Current: 65 mA (without backlight)
  • Alarm Current: 140 mA
  • Communications: RUI or RUI+ (remote unit interface)
  • Mounting: Top bay of the remote annunciator

Compatibility

Used in Simplex 4100ES/4100U remote annunciator panels that communicate with the host fire alarm control panel over RUI or RUI+ supervised wiring.

The Resideo THX1200W5/U is the white ElitePRO S1200 Smart Thermostat with Redlink 3.0, sold under the Honeywell Home brand. Built around a 5-inch touchscreen, it is designed for residential and light commercial 24 VAC systems, including heat pumps, fan coils, PTACs and radiant applications, and adds wireless sensors and indoor air quality monitoring.

Key Features

  • 5" touchscreen display with ambient light sensor
  • Supports up to 4H/2C heat pump systems, dual fuel with aux heat lockout, 2-pipe or 4-pipe fan coils, PTAC and radiant floor with slab sensor
  • Redlink 3.0 wireless link to indoor temperature/humidity/motion sensors, outdoor sensors and the EIM equipment interface module
  • IAQ sensing for humidity, VOC and estimated CO2; can control a humidifier, dehumidifier or ventilator
  • Dual-band Wi-Fi (2.4 & 5 GHz) with First Alert app access; Matter certified
  • Onboard radar sensor for occupancy detection; streams First Alert and Ring doorbell video

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Resideo (Honeywell Home)
  • Part Number: THX1200W5/U
  • Color: White
  • Power: 24 VAC to Rc and C required (no batteries); 2.6 VA
  • Setpoint Range: Heat 40–90 °F; cool 50–99 °F
  • Operating Ambient: 37–102 °F
  • Dimensions: 90 mm H x 133 mm W x 24 mm D
  • Mounting: UWP wall plate and cover plate included

Compatibility

Works with Resideo Redlink 3.0 accessories including the C7189R3010-2 wireless indoor sensor, C7089R3013 wireless outdoor sensor, EIM4010 equipment interface module and ERM4010, plus the THP9045A wire-saver (C-wire) module.

The Resideo TH3110U2008/U is a T3 Pro non-programmable thermostat for 1-heat/1-cool systems. It is aimed at contractors who need a simple, dependable wall thermostat: a large backlit display, straightforward up/down buttons and a rectangular footprint that helps cover marks left by an old thermostat. Because it is non-programmable, users simply set the temperature they want with the buttons and the T3 Pro holds that setpoint, which suits spaces that do not need a schedule.

Key Features

  • Non-programmable operation for 1H/1C applications
  • Large, backlit digital display
  • Intuitive vertical up/down buttons
  • ±1 °F comfort accuracy
  • Battery or common-wire powered, with settings memory during power outages and battery change alerts
  • Universal Wall Plate (UWP) for simpler replacement installs
  • Ready out of the box with minimal setup, per Resideo

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Resideo (Honeywell Home)
  • Part Number: TH3110U2008/U
  • Series: T3 Pro
  • Programming: Non-programmable
  • System Stages: 1 heat / 1 cool
  • Accuracy: ±1 °F
  • Power: Batteries or common (C) wire
  • Display: Large backlit digital display
  • Mounting: Universal Wall Plate (UWP)

The Ansul 431554 is the SENTRY CD10A-1, a 10 lb carbon dioxide hand portable fire extinguisher with a lightweight aluminum shell. Ansul designs its CO2 extinguishers for areas where Class B (flammable liquids and gases) or Class C (energized electrical equipment) fires could occur and a clean agent is required, such as laboratories and electronic equipment rooms.

Key Features

  • Non-corrosive, non-conductive CO2 agent that leaves no residue
  • Lightweight aluminum shell; aluminum models are UL and ULC listed
  • 36 in. (914 mm) discharge hose
  • Ring pin and visual seal help prevent unwanted discharge and show tampering
  • U.S. Coast Guard Type B:C, Size I when fitted with the heavy duty vehicle bracket (bracket P/N 79456)
  • Pictograph nameplate with operating and after-use instructions

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Ansul (SENTRY)
  • Part Number: 431554 (Model CD10A-1)
  • Agent Capacity: 10 lb (4.5 kg) carbon dioxide
  • UL/ULC Rating: 10-B:C
  • Max. Effective Range: 6 ft (1.8 m)
  • Discharge Time: 10 seconds
  • Charged Weight: 26-3/4 lb (12.1 kg) without horn/hose
  • Dimensions: 21-1/4 in. H x 10-15/16 in. W x 7 in. D
  • Service Pressure: 1800 psi (124 bar)
  • Operating Temperature: -22 °F to 120 °F
  • Hydrostatic Test: Every 5 years

Ansul's 431553 is the SENTRY CD05A-1, a compact 5 lb carbon dioxide hand portable fire extinguisher with an aluminum shell. It is intended for Class B (flammable liquids and gases) and Class C (energized electrical equipment) hazards indoors, where winds and drafts do not affect discharge or where a clean, residue-free agent is required.

Key Features

  • Clean, non-corrosive, non-conductive CO2 agent that leaves no residue
  • Lightweight aluminum shell; aluminum models are UL and ULC listed
  • Discharge tube with horn
  • Ring pin and self-destructing visual seal for easy tamper detection
  • U.S. Coast Guard Type B:C, Size I when fitted with the heavy duty vehicle bracket (bracket P/N 25419)
  • Suited to laboratories, electronic equipment and low voltage electrical equipment

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Ansul (SENTRY)
  • Part Number: 431553 (Model CD05A-1)
  • Agent Capacity: 5 lb (2.3 kg) carbon dioxide
  • UL/ULC Rating: 5-B:C
  • Max. Effective Range: 6 ft (1.8 m)
  • Discharge Time: 10 seconds
  • Charged Weight: 13-1/2 lb (6.1 kg) without horn/hose
  • Dimensions: 19 in. H x 7-1/4 in. W x 5-11/32 in. D
  • Service Pressure: 1800 psi (124 bar)
  • Operating Temperature: -22 °F to 120 °F
  • Hydrostatic Test: Every 5 years

The Resideo HM750ACYL/U is the replacement steam cylinder (canister) for the Honeywell Home HM750 Advanced Electrode Humidifier. Designed as a consumable part of the humidifier, it is built for fast, simple swap-outs so HVAC technicians can restore steam humidification with minimal downtime. In an electrode humidifier, current passes through the water inside the cylinder to produce steam, which is why the cylinder is the consumable component that is replaced during service.

Key Features

  • Direct replacement canister for the HM750 Electrode Humidifier
  • Designed for fast, simple cylinder replacement
  • Part of Resideo's replaceable-component system for the HM750 (PC boards, nozzles and hoses are also serviceable)
  • Ships with a salt tablet already inserted inside the steam cylinder
  • The salt tablet can be a source of rattling noises; this noise is normal

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Resideo (Honeywell Home)
  • Part Number: HM750ACYL/U
  • Product Type: Electrode humidifier replacement cylinder/canister
  • Included: Salt tablet pre-inserted in the steam cylinder

Compatibility

For use with the Resideo/Honeywell Home HM750 Advanced Electrode Humidifier.

The Amerex B500TS (Amerex item 15307) is a 5 lb ABC dry chemical fire extinguisher packaged with a two-strap vehicle bracket. Rated 2-A:10-B:C, it is intended for vehicle mounting, where a multipurpose extinguisher needs to stay secured in its bracket. The ABC agent addresses ordinary combustibles, flammable liquids and gases, and energized electrical equipment, so a single unit covers all three fire classes.

Key Features

  • Multipurpose ABC dry chemical for Class A, B and C fires
  • Includes a two-strap vehicle bracket
  • Aluminum valve with anodized aluminum valve body
  • Discharge hose for directing the agent
  • Large-loop pull pin and easy-to-read pressure gauge
  • Rechargeable; bilingual labels
  • On Class A fires, the agent melts at approximately 350 °F to chemically insulate the burning material

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Amerex
  • Part Number: 15307 (Model B500TS)
  • Agent: ABC dry chemical, 5 lb
  • UL Rating: 2-A:10-B:C
  • Range: 12–18 ft
  • Bracket: Two-strap vehicle bracket included
  • Valve: Anodized aluminum
  • Serviceability: Rechargeable

The Amerex 809G (Amerex item 21236) is a red heavy-duty box-type vehicle bracket for fire extinguishers with a 5 in. diameter cylinder. Amerex heavy-duty brackets are built to hold an extinguisher securely on trucks, equipment and other vehicles, where a standard wall hook would not keep the unit in place. Amerex's part description, BKT ASY 809G RD 5 VEH, identifies it as the red 5-inch vehicle bracket assembly in the 809 family.

Key Features

  • Heavy-duty box-type vehicle bracket design
  • Red finish; Amerex identifies its red heavy-duty box-type brackets as galvanized
  • Sized for a 5 in. diameter extinguisher cylinder
  • Fits 10 lb Amerex Z-Series/High Performance models 711 and 712 (per distributor listing)
  • Amerex part assembly: BKT ASY 809G RD 5 VEH
  • Standard 809 version is also offered in black

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Amerex
  • Part Number: 21236 (Model 809G)
  • Type: Heavy-duty vehicle bracket (box type)
  • Cylinder Diameter: 5 in.
  • Color: Red
  • Finish: Galvanized (red heavy-duty brackets per Amerex)
  • Part Description: BKT ASY 809G RD 5 VEH

The Notifier DAA2-5070 is a 120 VAC, 50-watt digital audio amplifier with a 70 VRMS speaker circuit output, part of Notifier's DAA2 series for the XLS-DVC Digital Voice Command. Connected to the digital audio loop (DAL), it receives and amplifies voice evacuation audio and distributes it to speaker circuits in emergency voice/alarm communication systems.

Key Features

  • 50 W total output power at 70 VRMS
  • Two Class A or four Class B speaker circuit outputs; four Class A with the optional DAA2 Class A Daughter Card (DCADC)
  • Amplifies one channel of digital audio, or two channels with an optional BDA card
  • Output activation through control-by-event equations in the XLS-DVC
  • Isolated alarm bus input for backup activation of alarm messages if digital communication is lost
  • Supports RM-1 remote microphone paging and a firefighter telephone (FFT) riser

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Notifier
  • Part Number: DAA2-5070
  • Input Voltage: 120 VAC
  • Output: 50 W, 70 VRMS speaker circuits
  • DAL Addressing: Occupies one of the 32 DAL addresses
  • Mounting: Chassis mounts in CAB-4 Series cabinets or EQCAB Series backboxes (CHS-ADP adapter for CAB-5)
  • Standards: Complies with NFPA 72, UL 864, ULC-S527

Compatibility

Designed for use with the Notifier XLS-DVC Digital Voice Command. Wire and fiber models of XLS-DVC, DAA2, DAX and DAA are compatible on a DAL; a DAA2 must be backed up by a BDA or another DAA2.

The Amerex 810 NONMAG (Amerex item 6572) is a red heavy-duty box-type vehicle bracket for extinguishers with a 7 in. diameter cylinder. It belongs to Amerex's heavy-duty vehicle bracket family, which is used to keep portable extinguishers secured on vehicles and in other mobile applications. The Amerex part description, BKT ASY 810 7 NM, identifies the 7-inch NM (NONMAG) assembly, and the 810 series is also offered in standard 810, 810CG and 810G versions.

Key Features

  • Heavy-duty box-type vehicle bracket
  • NONMAG (NM) version of the Amerex model 810
  • Sized for a 7 in. diameter extinguisher cylinder
  • Red finish
  • Amerex part assembly: BKT ASY 810 7 NM

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Amerex
  • Part Number: 6572 (also shown as 06572; Model 810 NONMAG)
  • Type: Heavy-duty vehicle bracket (box type)
  • Cylinder Diameter: 7 in.
  • Color: Red
  • Part Description: BKT ASY 810 7 NM
  • Bracket Family: Amerex 810 series (810, 810CG, 810NM, 810G)
  • Category: Amerex heavy-duty box-type vehicle brackets

The Ansul 431556 (Model CD20A-1) is the largest SENTRY carbon dioxide hand portable extinguisher, holding 20 lb of CO2 in an aluminum shell. It carries a UL/ULC rating of 10-B:C and is used where Class B or Class C fires could occur and a clean agent is required, such as electrical rooms, laboratories and equipment areas.

Key Features

  • 20 lb CO2 capacity in a lightweight aluminum shell
  • Clean, non-corrosive, non-conductive agent that leaves no residue
  • UL and ULC listed (aluminum models)
  • 36 in. (914 mm) discharge hose
  • Ring pin and visual seal to help prevent unwanted discharge
  • Bright red powder paint finish resists cracking and chipping

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Ansul (SENTRY)
  • Part Number: 431556 (Model CD20A-1)
  • Agent Capacity: 20 lb (9.1 kg) carbon dioxide
  • UL/ULC Rating: 10-B:C
  • Max. Effective Range: 6 ft (1.8 m)
  • Discharge Time: 13 seconds
  • Charged Weight: 46-3/4 lb (21.2 kg) without horn/hose
  • Dimensions: 28 in. H x 12 in. W x 8-3/32 in. D
  • Service Pressure: 1800 psi (124 bar)
  • Operating Temperature: -22 °F to 120 °F
  • Bracket: P/N 25420 (not Coast Guard approved)

The Resideo TB7220U1012/U is a CommercialPRO 7000 programmable commercial thermostat for light commercial gas, oil, electric and heat pump equipment. It handles up to 2 heat/2 cool conventional or 3 heat/2 cool heat pump systems and adds commercial features such as an economizer/time-of-day output and remote indoor or outdoor sensing.

Key Features

  • 7-day programmable, or configurable for non-programmable operation
  • Economizer / Time-of-Day (TOD) output on terminal A, energized during occupied periods or cooling calls
  • Supports remote indoor or outdoor temperature sensors
  • Large backlit display shows current temperature, setpoint and time; clock is kept through power outages and updates for daylight saving time
  • Holiday override, armchair programming and settings lockout
  • Manual or automatic changeover; Energy Star product

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Resideo (Honeywell Home)
  • Part Number: TB7220U1012/U
  • Series: CommercialPRO 7000
  • System Stages: Up to 2H/2C conventional or 3H/2C heat pump
  • Power: Batteries only, 24 VAC only, or 24 VAC with AA battery backup
  • Setpoint Range: Heat 40–90 °F; cool 50–99 °F
  • Dimensions: 3-3/4 in. H x 6 in. W x 1-3/8 in. D

The Siemens MS-501 (500-620522) is a double action manual station, or pull station, with an SPST contact. It is a non-coded manual fire alarm box for conventional fire alarm control panels: the double action design requires two distinct motions to activate the station, which helps deter accidental operation. Its SPST (single pole, single throw) normally open contact closes when the station is operated, signaling an alarm on the panel's initiating circuit.

Key Features

  • Double action operation to help deter accidental activation
  • SPST contact (one normally open contact)
  • Non-coded manual station for conventional fire alarm control panels
  • Key switch per distributor listing
  • Siemens stock number 500-620522

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Siemens
  • Part Number: MS-501 (500-620522)
  • Action: Double action
  • Contacts: SPST, one normally open
  • Type: Non-coded manual fire alarm station
  • Application: Conventional fire alarm control panels
  • Coding: Non-coded

Compatibility

For use with conventional fire alarm control panels (FACPs) with a normally open initiating circuit input.

The Napco SLE-MAXV-Z is a StarLink Connect MAX dual-path alarm communicator for Verizon's CAT-M1 (LTE-M) cellular network, with IP and optional Wi-Fi paths. Napco classes the MAX series as multi-function Commercial Burglary and Residential Fire alarm communicators that capture panel signals and send them to a central station, while adding Connected Home / Business app control.

Key Features

  • Dual path: Verizon CAT-M1 cellular plus TCP/IP via hardwired Ethernet or optional Wi-Fi adapter (Wi-Fi not used for Commercial Burglary)
  • Includes the SLE-ZWAVE-MOD Z-Wave module for control of Z-Wave devices, schedules and scenes
  • Upload/download to NAPCO, Honeywell and DSC control panels
  • iBridge Messenger SMS/email notifications and remote control via mobile app
  • Powered directly from the control panel; SIM card included; white plastic enclosure

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Napco
  • Part Number: SLE-MAXV-Z
  • Network: Verizon CAT-M1, Verizon certified
  • Input Power: 12 VDC regulated from panel; 110 mA standby, add 135 mA when transmitting
  • Dimensions: 8 x 5-29/64 x 1-1/2 in.
  • Operating Environment: 32–120 °F, 93% RH max; indoor/dry only
  • Certifications: UL 985, UL 1610, UL 1076, UL 365 (conditions per Napco instructions)

Compatibility

Compatible with most 12 VDC alarm control panels, including NAPCO, Honeywell and DSC, per Napco (see Napco WI2468 for details).

The Edwards 868STRA-N5 is a bright, low current, high decibel combination electronic horn/strobe from Edwards Signaling, designed for surface mounting indoors or outdoors. Powered by 120 VAC, it comes with a weatherproof mount and provides both audible and visual alerts for fire alarm, process control and general signaling applications.

Key Features

  • Combination electronic horn and strobe in one surface-mount unit
  • Strobe and horn can be operated independently
  • High output: 100 dB at 1 m / 90 dB at 10 ft
  • Amber lens; gray engineered thermoplastic housing
  • Weatherproof mount for indoor or outdoor use
  • Low current draw of 0.021 A

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Edwards (Edwards Signaling)
  • Part Number: 868STRA-N5
  • Voltage: 120 VAC, 50/60 Hz
  • Current: 0.021 A
  • Sound Output: 100 dB at 1 m; 90 dB at 10 ft (anechoic)
  • Flash Rate: 60 flashes per minute
  • Lens Color: Amber
  • Outdoor Temperature Range: -31 °F to 150 °F (-35 °C to 66 °C)

The Edwards GCFR-HDVM is a red Genesis field-configurable ceiling horn-strobe with FIRE marking and selectable 15 to 95 candela output. Operating on 24 V notification appliance circuits, it is used in fire alarm systems where a compact, low-profile ceiling-mounted audible/visible signal is required.

Key Features

  • Field-selectable 15, 30, 75 or 95 cd output; setting stays visible after installation
  • FullLight strobe technology for an even light distribution pattern
  • Temporal horn with high/low dB setting (low reduces output about 5 dB)
  • Protrudes no more than 1.6 in. (41 mm); red textured housing with FIRE marking
  • Single pair of wires with independent horn control
  • Fits standard North American 4 in. square electrical boxes; #18–#12 AWG terminals

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Edwards
  • Part Number: GCFR-HDVM
  • Operating Voltage: 16–33 VDC filtered or 16–33 V FWR (24 V nominal)
  • Candela: 15/30/75/95 cd selectable
  • Flash Rate: 1 flash per second
  • Mounting: 4 in. square box, 2-1/8 in. deep; ceiling
  • Operating Environment: Indoor, 32–120 °F, 93% RH
  • Listings: UL 1971, UL 1638, ULC-S525/S526; CSFM, MEA, FM

Compatibility

Synchronizes with Edwards sync sources including G1M-RM, SIGA-CC1S, SIGA-MCC1S, BPS6A and BPS10A.

The Napco GEM-P816 is a Gemini P816 Series economical hardwire/wireless security control panel supplied with its transformer. It offers 8 hybrid zones on board, including two 2-wire fire zones, and can grow to 16 zones, making it a flexible choice for residential and small commercial intrusion and fire installations.

Key Features

  • 8 to 16 hardwire zones/points, including two 2-wire fire zones
  • Expandable up to 16 EOL zones with multiplexing (built-in EZMs)
  • Up to 16 user codes and up to 7 keypads
  • Supports 2 Gemini wireless receivers and 3 outputs
  • 256-event log, interior bypass group and auto arm
  • EZ programming at the keypad, plus PC up/downloading

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Napco
  • Part Number: GEM-P816
  • Series: Gemini P816
  • Zones: 8 on board, expandable to 16 (includes two 2-wire fire zones)
  • User Codes: Up to 16
  • Keypads: Up to 7
  • Event Log: 256 events
  • Included: Control panel and transformer

Compatibility

Works with Napco Gemini keypads and Gemini RF receivers and transmitters; optional NetLink intranet/internet alarm reporting and GEM-X10 interface.

The Notifier DP-T2A-CB4 is a dress panel that mounts a 10" touch screen display and two ACM-30 annunciators in a Notifier CAB-4 cabinet. It gives the display and annunciator hardware a finished, organized mounting surface inside the CAB-4 enclosure. The touch screen display, ACM-30 annunciators and CAB-4 cabinet are separate items, so order each component the installation requires.

Key Features

  • Dress panel for Notifier CAB-4 series enclosures
  • Mounting provision for one 10" touch screen display
  • Mounting provision for two ACM-30 annunciator modules
  • Gives a clean, finished appearance around the display and annunciators
  • Combines a touch screen display and two ACM-30 annunciators on one panel front

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Notifier
  • Part Number: DP-T2A-CB4
  • Product Type: Dress panel
  • Enclosure: CAB-4
  • Mounts: One 10" touch screen display and two ACM-30 annunciators

Compatibility

Designed to mount in a Notifier CAB-4 cabinet, holding a 10" touch screen display plus two ACM-30 annunciators, as stated in the manufacturer's part description.

The Resideo HZ221K/U is a TrueZONE kit that bundles the HZ221 zone panel, a discharge air temperature sensor (DATS) and a 40 VA transformer. The HZ221 panel is intended for single stage heat pumps with auxiliary heat in applications of up to two zones, letting contractors add forced-air zoning with the core components in one box.

Key Features

  • Complete kit: HZ221 zone panel, C7735A1000 discharge air sensor and AT140A1042 40 VA transformer
  • Two zones; 2H/1C heat pump with auxiliary electric heat
  • Robust push terminals and common-sense LEDs
  • Smaller footprint for a clean, professional installation
  • Variable-speed fan control
  • Mounts on a wall, return duct or stud

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Resideo (Honeywell Home)
  • Part Number: HZ221K/U
  • Input: 18–30 VAC, 50/60 Hz, transformer of 40 VA or more
  • Panel Current Draw: 6.25 VA max.
  • Wiring: 18-gauge solid wire
  • Operating Temperature: -40 to 165 °F
  • Panel Dimensions: 8 in. x 8-1/8 in. x 1-55/64 in.

Compatibility

Works with ZD, ARD, MARD and RRD series zone dampers (size the transformer for damper VA). Only compatible with heat pump thermostats that use a cool changeover valve terminal (O).

The Potter INTELLICOM-5GV is a 5G LTE-M dual path commercial fire alarm communicator for the Verizon network, part of Potter's IntelliCom Advanced Gateway line. It gives any commercial fire panel sole or dual path cellular monitoring, connecting to Potter panels over Ethernet and to other panels through a single DACT connection.

Key Features

  • 5G LTE-M cellular communication on Verizon
  • Direct Ethernet connection to Potter panels (Contact ID and SIA) with no UD-2000 dialer required
  • Universal DACT interface for other manufacturers' panels
  • Meets UL 864 requirements for sole, primary or backup path; 5- or 60-minute supervision
  • Works with any local or national central station
  • IntelliView app and cloud tools: alerts, program backup, remote programming and one-person walk test on Potter panels

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Potter
  • Part Number: INTELLICOM-5GV
  • Network: 5G LTE-M (Verizon)
  • Primary Power: 12 VAC or 12/24 VDC (29 VDC max); plug-in transformer included
  • Current: 68 mA standby, 140 mA transmit @ 24 VDC
  • Dimensions: 7.5 in. H x 11.5 in. W x 3.5 in. D
  • Enclosure: Red, locking metal
  • Agency: ANSI/UL 864; FCC; NYC Fire Dept COA 2023-TMCOAP-008284-CERT

Compatibility

Direct Ethernet connection to Potter IPA-4000(V), IPA-100, IPA-60, AFC-1000(V), AFC-100, AFC-50, ARC-100 and PFC-4064 panels; other fire panels with a dialer connect via DACT (Contact ID, SIA DC03, 4x2/3x1 pulse, Radionics, DMP).

The Resideo 40003918-008/U is an adaptor kit for V4043E, V4043J and V8043J low pressure steam zone valves.
